messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Tamil, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Tamil line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
அந்த பணிவான இத்தாலி இரட்சிப்பாக இருக்கும் அதற்காக கன்னிய காமில்லா இறந்தாள், ஈரியலோ, டர்னோ, நிசோ காயமடைந்தவர்கள்.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase (Tamil) | Back‑Translation (Eng.) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|------------------------------|--------------------------|--------| | Di | “of” – genitive marker linking *salute* to *Italia* | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** (Tamil omits the preposition) | | quella | demonstrative “that” specifying the Italy | அந்த | “that” | OK | | umile | attribute “humble” describing Italy | பணிவான | “humble” | OK | | Italia | proper noun “Italy” | இத்தாலி | “Italy” | OK | | fia | future copula “shall be” | இருக்கும் | “shall be / will be” | OK | | salute | noun “salvation” (the state of being saved) | இரட்சிப்பு | “salvation” | OK | | per | causal preposition “for which / because of” | அதற்காக | “for which / because of” | OK | | cui | relative pronoun “which” (refers to the salvation) | அதற்காக | “for which” (same as above) | OK | | morì | past verb “died” | இறந்தாள் | “died (feminine)” | OK | | la | definite article “the” (feminine) | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** (Tamil has no articles) | | vergine | noun “virgin” (title of Camilla) | கன்னிய | “virgin” | OK | | Cammilla | proper name “Camilla” | காமில்லா | “Camilla” | OK | | Eurialo | proper name “Euryalus” | ஈரியலோ | “Euryalus” | OK | | e (1st) | coordinating conjunction “and” | — (comma used) | — | **UNNECESSARY** (conjunction expressed by commas) | | Turno | proper name “Turnus” | டர்னோ | “Turnus” | OK | | e (2nd) | coordinating conjunction “and” | — (comma used) | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | Niso | proper name “Nisus” | நிசோ | “Nisus” | OK | | di | preposition “of” introducing the participial phrase | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | ferute | participial adjective “wounded” (state of the three) | காயமடைந்தவர்கள் | “the wounded (people)” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: Di, la, both occurrences of **e**, and **di** (preposition). These elements are naturally omitted or rendered by punctuation in Tamil. - No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Tamil script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Tamil text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 106** - Original: அந்த பணிவான இத்தாலி இரட்சிப்பாக இருக்கும் - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- **Line 107** - Original: அதற்காக கன்னிய காமில்லா இறந்தாள், - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- **Line 108** - Original: ஈரியலோ, டர்னோ, நிசோ காயமடைந்தவர்கள். - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
